system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: the agent logic is encapsulated in acontext manager(described in Section 6.2.1) that composes prompts from the current state
system_prompt_style.note: Experience snippets are injected into the prompt: {system prompt}<EXP>{exp g}</EXP>{query} (paper Sec. 4.2). Prompt-building code is not in the evidence bundle.

env_context_strategy.note: Context injection is environment-dependent (AppWorld/BFCL services). The default tool list and instance template are not in the evidence.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: When its size exceeds a predefined threshold, the Context Manager summarizes older content into a compressed memory messageand initializes a new timeline window
context_compaction.note: Context-managing templates are selectable: basic causal (no compaction), sliding window (summarize), and self-context managing (keep/remove/compress). The default template is not shown. Games SummarizedMemory also summarizes history.

observation_format.note: The observation conversion code is not in the evidence.

tool_call_format.note: The action parser is not in the evidence.

tool_count.note: Tools are provided by the environment services; no tool registry is in the evidence.

edit_primitive.note: No edit tool definitions are in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: No schema code is in the evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: The repository was truncated, so no grep of dependencies was possible.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent then repeats the observe–act cycle until termination
loop_primitives.note: Training uses multiple rollouts per task, grouped for GRPO; this is training, not selection. Planner-executor is possible via a custom context manager (code change).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: structured prompts encourage the model to generate <think> tokens before decisions

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Each worker interacts with the environment to initialize instances, execute actions, and collect observations
multi_agent_topology.note: Game Arena (games/) is multi-agent (Avalon, Diplomacy) and is a separate extension.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The basic unit for sampling a trajectory.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Web-based interaction – Observe AI agents' reasoning and communication in real time, or participate as a human player.
human_in_loop.note: A human player in the games replaces an agent; per the rule this is not HITL.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Live Context Timeline (LCT)— a mutable sequence representing the agent’s current working context during multi-turn interaction.

long_term_memory.note: ReMe experience pool is optional; basic.yaml runs without ReMe.

state_persistence.note: No resume code is in the evidence.

self_verification.note: Used for training reward, not as a runtime check.
